text: {"lessons":["A few monthly gains or losses are not enough to judge an investment; I should make decisions based on a longer-term plan, not short-term price moves.","Buying all five stocks at once and adding more soon after taught me to check my overall allocation and keep enough cash before investing further.","Selling Stock D at a loss while adding to Stock A is not a strategy by itself; I should reassess each holding on its merits rather than react to losses or recent price changes."]}
